result_text:
The contributor tables and the bar chart no longer use `contributorsListLimit`, so every contributor is exported. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or generate a report to look at the output.

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`:** I removed `.limit(limit)` from the table stream and the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. This class builds `contributors.html` and `contributors-recent.html`. I didn't look at how the bots and teams pages are built, so I can't say whether they go through the same class.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`:** I removed the `.limit(...)` on `recentContributors`, so the "contributors sorted by recent commits" chart gets one bar per recently active contributor.

The sort order is unchanged, and `contributorsListLimit` is still in `LandscapeConfiguration` and `config.json`. Nothing reads it for these lists any more.
